title: 第1387章 天虚仙城大乱招收修士第1386章 妖魔法宝神秘残片
slug: 五灵根修炼慢我有百倍灵药空间
content_zh:
来到外面，陆青禾竟然感应到了无数的法力波动在天虚仙城各个角落。
这让陆青禾很是震惊，仙城之内怎么会出现这么多法术气息的。
他神识感应之下，脸色很是难看，三分之一的仙城竟然被毁去。
放在以前他不会多管闲事，可是现在这仙城属于他，他是名义上的仙城之主。
虽然不被人知道，但是如此破坏，这完全是破坏他的利益。
这样下去，要不了几年，仙城就会被毁去。
陆青禾急忙找到林傲霜和月无瑕，看到两女没事，他才松了口气。
陆青禾对着林傲霜问道：“天虚仙城现在怎么回事？”
林傲霜看到陆青禾出现，眉眼的担忧散去，她一直担心陆青禾的安全，更是担心陆青禾进入天虚之中。
现在天虚关闭，不知道多少修士被困在天虚之中。
林傲霜开口道：“数月之前，天虚传送大阵消失，天虚之外的防御阵法消失，有人猜测紫城主陨落在天虚之中。”
“现在天虚仙城成了无主之物，这里聚集的修士八成以上都是散修，之前有着城主镇压，大家都遵循规则。”
“现在城主消失，天虚关闭，这里成了别人眼中的肥肉，杀人夺宝，混乱就此开始，开始的时候大家还能克制，可随着争斗规模越来越大。
城主府都没有出动人镇压，现在几乎是肆无忌惮。”
“我们这里也受到几次攻击，幸好玄老出手，将这些人镇压。”
陆青禾很快明白了怎么回事，脸色阴沉，这些人竟然在这个时候作乱，让整个天虚仙城陷入混乱之中。
不过还好，大多数炼虚修士都进入天虚之中，特别是炼虚后期之上的修士都进入天虚之中抢夺资源。
不然陆家仙地都要遭遇无法想象的灾难。
毕竟陆家在别人看来财富太多了。
林傲霜建议：“天虚关闭，不知道多少修士困在里面，天虚仙城很快就会成为灾难之地，还可能有其他仙城的修士，仙门势力介入其中。

我们是不是提前离开。”
林傲霜认为现在天虚仙城已经没有利益可图，趁着现在天虚仙城诡异的情况没有传出去，离开才是最好的选择。
等消息传出，不知道多少仙城和仙门会对天虚仙城出手。
一座天虚仙城的财富难以想象。
陆青禾却摇头：“紫城主是出现了意外，但是之前我和你们说过，我和紫城主谈了交易，已经完成了交易，这天虚仙城现在是属于我的了。”
陆青禾想了一下，他并没有立刻恢复仙城的大阵，这需要令牌催动，还需要不少的灵脉。
想要镇压一座仙城没有这样简单。
他将摄魂铃拿了出来，交给林傲霜：“你放出消息，陆家招收无数修士，修为在化神大圆满、半步炼虚以及炼虚的修士。”
“化神大圆满和半步炼虚修士可以一次性获得一颗破妄仙丹，以后购买的任何丹药都是七折优惠，炼虚修士可以一次性获得十颗皇丹，以后购买皇丹六折优惠。”
“这个期限为500年，500年之后可以解除契约，离开陆家。”
content_en:
When he came outside, Lu Qinghe sensed countless mana fluctuations in every corner of Tianxu Fairy City.
This shocked Lu Qinghe, how could there be so much magic aura in the fairy city.
Under the influence of his spiritual consciousness, his face was very ugly, and one third of the fairy city was destroyed.
In the past, he would not meddle in other people's business, but now this fairy city belongs to him, and he is the nominal master of the fairy city.
Although it is not known, but it is so damaging, it is completely damaging to his interests.
If this continues, the fairy city will be destroyed in a few years.
Lu Qinghe hurriedly found Lin Aoshuang and Yue Wuxia, and he was relieved when he saw that the two women were fine.
Lu Qinghe asked Lin Aoshuang, "What's going on in Tianxu Immortal City now?"
When Lin Aoshuang saw Lu Qinghe appear, the worry on her face disappeared. She had been worried about Lu Qinghe's safety, and she was even more worried about Lu Qinghe entering Tianxu.
Now that Tianxu is closed, no one knows how many monks are trapped in Tianxu.
Lin Aoshuang said: "A few months ago, Tianxu's teleportation formation disappeared, and the defensive formations outside Tianxu disappeared. Some people speculated that the Purple City Lord fell in Tianxu."
"Now Tianxu Immortal City has become ownerless. More than 80% of the monks gathered here are casual cultivators. Before, the city lord suppressed it, and everyone followed the rules."
"Now that the city lord has disappeared and Tianxu is closed, this place has become a fat place in the eyes of others. People are killing people and grabbing treasures. The chaos has begun. At the beginning, everyone can restrain themselves, but as the scale of the battle becomes larger and larger.
The city lord's palace did not send anyone to suppress it, and now it is almost unscrupulous. "
"We have also been attacked several times here. Fortunately, Mr. Xuan took action and suppressed these people."
Lu Qinghe quickly understood what was going on, and his face was gloomy. These people actually made trouble at this time, plunging the entire Tianxu Immortal City into chaos.
Fortunately, most of the monks who refine the void have entered the sky, especially the monks who are in the late stage of the cultivation, and they have entered the sky to snatch resources.
Otherwise, the Lu Family Immortal Land will encounter an unimaginable disaster.
After all, the Lu family has too much wealth in the eyes of others.
Lin Aoshuang suggested: "Tianxu is closed, and I don't know how many monks are trapped inside. Tianxu Fairy City will soon become a place of disaster. There may also be monks from other fairy cities, and fairy sect forces are involved.
Did we leave early. "
Lin Aoshuang believes that there is no profit to be made in Tianxu Immortal City now, and leaving is the best choice before the strange situation in Tianxu Immortal City is spread.
When the news comes out, I don’t know how many immortal cities and immortal gates will take action against Tianxu Immortal City.
The wealth of a Tianxu Immortal City is unimaginable.
Lu Qinghe shook his head: "The Purple City Lord had an accident, but I told you before that I negotiated a deal with the Purple City Lord and the deal has been completed. This Tianxu Immortal City now belongs to me."
Lu Qinghe thought for a moment, and he did not immediately restore the fairy city's formation. This required tokens to activate and a lot of spiritual veins.
It is not that simple to suppress a fairy city.
He took out the soul-catching bell and handed it to Lin Aoshuang: "Spread the news that the Lu family is recruiting countless monks, monks with cultivation levels in the Great Perfection of God Transformation, Half-step Void Refining, and Void Refining."
"The Great Perfection of God Transformation and Half-Step Void Refining monks can get one Delusion-Breaking Immortal Pill at one time, and any elixir purchased in the future will be discounted at 30%. The Void Refining Monk can get ten Imperial Pills at one time, and there will be a 40% discount on future purchases of Imperial Pills."
"This period is 500 years. After 500 years, you can terminate the contract and leave the Lu family."
